page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries, left column then right column, each read top to bottom. The right column has a small large-initial "D." heading and ends with a catchword "Deum" at the lower right. Running head "INDEX" at the top centre. No page number printed. A partly visible neighbouring page at the right edge is not transcribed.

page.notes: The entry "Christi cognitio unde Apostolis innotuerit" is partly struck through or overprinted with ink, so the reading is doubtful. "DAuid [?] charitatis": the large initial D is joined to the word, and the next word is uncertain. The line-end hyphen in "diuinita-tem" is printed. The entries "Consortium" and "Credentes nihilominus instituí" are read from a slightly blurred scan; "Consortium" may be "Consortium" or "Consortium" with a different letter, so check it. The page number is not printed; "INDEX" is the running head, the X. after it is treated as a sign and omitted. Ink show-through and a neighbouring page edge at the right are not transcribed.
